answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through cognitive proof-of-compute challenges. Gateways establish an ingress jetty where unverified nodes must solve multi-constraint generative tasks, like embedding dynamic session salts into a structured sonnet, before embarking on their transactional voyage. This forces an attacker to incur the verifiable cost of frontier-model GPU inference per identity. However, rapid model distillation continually lowers adversary costs.
